history.question: Ventas por categoría
history.sql: SELECT p.category AS "Categoría", SUM(o.amount) AS "Ventas" FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC;
history.narrative: La categoría **Electronics** lidera claramente las ventas con **133414**. A bastante distancia le siguen **Furniture** con **55477.2**, **Accessories** con **15502.76** y **Office Supplies** con **5700.87**. El reparto muestra una fuerte concentración en Electronics.

history.question: Total sales per month in 2025
history.sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS "Month",
    SUM(amount) AS "Total sales"
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01'
    AND order_date < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)
)
SELECT
  "Month",
  "Total sales"
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY "Month";
history.narrative: Monthly sales in 2025 range from **6,265.81** in **2025-09** to **14,993.40** in **2025-11**. Sales are strongest in **March**, **January**, and **November**, and weakest in **September** and **June**. The pattern is mixed across the year, with a noticeable peak in late 2025.
